sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Rice that has spilled forth from the hand of the Divine Child of Rejuvenation. Divine Child of Rejuvenation. Intended to be a gift for Kuro.
"Rice is precious.
I want nothing more than for the Divine Heir of the Dragon's Heritage to get better."
Kuro would likely be pleased to receive it.
Given by the Divine Child of Rejuvenation after being gifted Rice at least three times, and then curing her sickness with a Persimmon or Taro Persimmon.
Give to Kuro before defeating the Divine Dragon as part of the Return Ending, in return for Sweet Rice Balls.
